description: P3-3: the D execution control plane (worker leases with fencing, exit-point re-checks, four-stage cancel with observed stop, reconcile-from-observation, partition-scoped idempotency) plus the first workers — a process worker supervising real subprocesses and a Playwright browser worker driving the local test site. ADR 0020 shape: one control plane, workers isolated by resource/failure boundary, six-call semantics and ADR 0011 parameters unchanged.
name: @infosec/execution

scripts.pretest: npm --prefix ../contracts run build && npm --prefix ../platform run build && npm --prefix ../test-site run build && tsc -b .
